text: Lot of bugs. Doesn't allow you to play a move if distracted by a call or pop-up. Gets stuck. Why do you have an idle time out in Blitz , what is the logic ?? If we get a call and come back, it timeout Pathetic app, degrading day by day. sometimes it takes infinity to start the game, you will have to close and start again. even with a proper network in the cell phone it starts showing only 1 signal and hangs the game in between. It just increases stress instead of mind relaxation.

Yeah, that's a really good game for beginners to learn and visualise chess while also playing it with others online and there is no problem in this game except one, that everyone knows " too many "subscriptions". Like I also have that diamond membership once, but I cancelled it and now the app is showing offers for it every time.So in conclusion,this game is fantastic 😍

I really like this app because it has a good rating system, many options and ways to improve your skills. Some of them are free like practice sections and cordinates and moves practice, but some of them need the premium diamond (subscription) . They have game reviews, move explaination and etc. For your understanding of the game. Finally, the game is really good and is must to download.

I've been playing this game for years now. The app itself is great, the bots, the puzzles, and the analysis. Overall rate—10/10. I just cooked one of my best matches. I suggest adding a new list of games beside the Game History. It would be great if there were a feature where I can save my best games. So that finding a specific game is easy when i need it like showing my brilliant moves to my pears. And that we can display on our profile like a playlist.

The game is extremely good and has a wide player base so finding good players is fast. The ui is also extremely simple and easy to understand. The only reason I gave it 1 less star is that most of the times, in android when connected to a bluetooth audio device, the sound of the pieces either never comes or comes in between with a significant delay, if it gets fixed I would rate it a 5 stars.

A great app where you can see reviews, learn mistakes and play a new game with better tactics. The thing which I liked the most is that we can play with players of different countries of similar ratings. We can also play with ai and with coaches who will help you with the best moves Rely upon me and surely you will be great in the game of chess.

Great for learning but when playing bots it would better (in my opinion) if you could do take back on the last move rather than it ending the game completely so you can learn from your mistake and replay it so you can try a different move, I'm very new to chess and often end in a draw or get check mated without seeing it coming and although you can review the game and see where you went wrong I think it would help me at least to be able to take back the game ending move and continue.

great app. I just hate the change they made that makes that awful annoying sound when the king is in check and you touch any other piece. I like having sounds enabled in the game but not that annoying fart sound with the king in check. please let us disable that. just a flashing red square is enough of a reminder for me.

Most popular chess app, but I have issues. Sub price, drop that to like $2 and Id pay, but its the price of a netflix sub. Puzzles, you get 3 a day as free. takes way too long to get out of the "find mate in 1-2 moves" Analysis of games, only one a day? Then the ads pop up a lot lately, and constantly telling you to get the overpriced premium. My advice? Theres another app that gives you all this for free. With plenty of community guides for learning.

When I was playing a game and I clearly drew (three fold repetition), the game for some reason didn't register it as a draw and I lost on time. (moves: Kf7, Re6, Kg7, Kf5, Kf7. Ke5, Ke7, Kf5...). the game was a theoretical draw as well. also, the game review screen right after a game shows that I've made X amount of brilliant moves and great moves, but when I load in game review, it decreases that number drastically. so I don't know if the first game review screen is clickbait or not.

I've been using chess for a getting close to a year now and have zero complaints. This is by far the best app for chess. When it comes down to special features the app gives you without the membership it's super amazing, all though I would love if you could have a little bit more than 3 puzzles a day to practice more. The learning aspects in the app are wonderful compared to others, I have the ability to have a coach if my choosing review my game after i play a good or bad game. Great game.

Update : I submitted for refund and was only given a partial refund. The APP still stole from me. Original below. The billing is predatory. The 'Free Trial' system automatically signs you up for a full year subscription at the most expensive tier. You are not given notice, nor does it ask for positive confirmation of billing. I have not received a refund for a charge that I did not sign up for.

I like how this app is welcoming to new players like me, and the coach is very helpful with explaining mistakes, and the absence of advertisements. But sometimes when I do custom puzzles I make the right move but it says I got it wrong, and I also don't appreciate the meager amount of puzzles and lessons I can do before I am asked to pay for a subscription

Very fun! I like the lessons, puzzles, coach games. While it's fun, the app is often buggy with pretty noticeable bugs that they take a long time to fix. it took 2 months to fix being stuck in the same lesson. now the daily puzzle checkmarks are missing from the calendar and it's been that way for a while. they often take weeks or months to respond to a support inquiry so who knows when they'll see my report. I'd be pissed if I was paying for the app but since I'm not, I can't really be mad.

The paywall is absurd and borderline scam. You pay for terrible puzzles, being able to play bots that seem to be designed to make you hate this app and it makes you pay for game analysis, which you can find for free everywhere else. The higher membership tiers offer you move explanations among other things, which is laughable, as it "explains" moves like "This move was good, because it was a good move." The only positive thing is that they seem to genuinely care about fair play.

Great place to play chess. Games are easy to find and totally free. The pool of players is huge. Up till now I've had no technical problems in my games. They say there are loads of cheaters, but I haven't encountered any, as far as I can tell. The only downside to the site is that there is a pay wall for almost everything else. I just export the pgn of my games to Lichess and analyse them there. Same with my studies and puzzles.

I am playing exclusively on Android mobile app. players league used to be accessible via starting page - icon next to Streaks. it is not there anymore and I cannot find it anywhere. btw, your AI Support isn't helpful at all, offered options after their response do not include a possibility of a follow up question and ALL AI responses were absolutely incorrect or irrelevant.

Waay to slow last 10 years (still at june 2026), its impossible to play 1 min games on this server - Lichess works much much better. This makes me abandon this platform, it's not fun to play when there is a time lag on about 8 seconds on some moves every game. If you fix this I will happily return, but while this is not fixed it's not worth playing here as there are better options. This has been a problem for some years now.

This game is supposed to be good but recently, I have noticed a couple of issues when playing that are clearly cheated moves. I have screenshots to back this up and would like the team to look into it. There is a lot of cheating in the game these days...my opponents pawn is somehow able to kill backwards and forwards... the pawn is supposed to take one step forward and kill at the sides...now this time, somehow, other players pawn are able to make foul moves that aren't possible in chess history

this app is great in the game play and puzzles but when play against opponents, what really annoys me is the "auto resign" feature where a few moments of poor connection means you lose the game. also, recently I played a game where my time kept going even on my opponents move then the app just stop reacting. the guy was like "bro are you still there" I could read his messages but still couldn't make a move; for him it was like I was wasting my time but I couldn't do anything not even know when h

The addition of Ads for free play made sense, but less frequent would have kept me playing longer. Ads for every move of 1/day games just got to be nuts. It worked out to dozens of ads per game of chess. I dropped to just doing puzzles. Then the app logged me out, and attempted password recovery said my account doesn't exist. Easy choice to uninstall at that point.

I played this chess, trying to be considered how the game works. I know chess is not just the game, but. I love more learning on my life. I love how is chess teach, things never lets us get a little mistake on the first place, try to be forces and use our habit skills help lots of better. This is one the best experiences where you could find it. noticed. the cause the abilities of best moves for prompt were could never be stress or might be never be mistakenly for possibly for sometime chances

The "Out of This World" event is completely missing from my account. Since the day this event was launched, it has never appeared for me. I can see and play the event bots, but the event page, missions, points, progress track, and rewards do not appear at all. I have already updated the app, reinstalled it, cleared the cache, and tried every possible fix. I would appreciate it if you could look into this issue and help resolve it. Thank you.

Laggy and unfair the game system. Playing the game while kicking you out in the middle of your game without knowing what happened. Not even a notification was sent. I have my internet provider gives me the right connectivity during my games, i'm monitoring it with continouos speed/latency test. My "turn TIME" seems moves faster than my opponent and it skips the timer to lessen my time left. I have recorded my games and seen this CHEATING system. There's a cheating system in the game. Dishonesty.

decent enough app but spoilt by long adverts. they pretend they're only 5 or 10 seconds long but after the countdown, you have to wait extra seconds for additional dialog boxes where you press the X button to close them. Takes about 20 seconds to get through them. It's simpler to just close the app and restart. Takes 3 or 4 seconds. thanks for the offer but I prefer a long term solution. Ads are fine. Just tell me they're 20 seconds long otherwise it's a bad reflection on you.

I was new to chess and now I have an almost 700 day streak. Best game ever. I love that it's free, no ads, and you can play with people all across the globe. Premium has also felt worth the price as it really helps to analyze every game and learn from lessons and puzzles. Big fan. Don't change!

idk if this app was sold to someone else or what, but they just introduced advertisements on free accounts. not to mention the changes they've made lately to the AI difficulty and puzzles. both are geared more toward making you feel like you're improving while not actually doing so cuz they're way easier. i went from rarely beating an 1800 AI before to winning every time. they make stupidly obviously blunders when theyre winning. anyway, I'll be looking for a different app to play on.

True definition of perfect and competitive. However, my only addition is that if you can add a feature that will allow one see the people watching his game while he's playing, that will be really nice. Also, please do work on the network requirements of this app, sometimes a little network glitch will make you lose a game by abandonment.

The app itself is okay though I have experienced better elsewhere. I mostly play 1 day/move games to give time to think and work, sleep etc and it constantly matched me to players with lesser ratings. As soon as I won against opponents I would normally beat, it closed my account for their so called "fair play policy". At least, they let me keep whatever premium I had left but definitely cancelling that and this account is only for deliberately losing games because that's their definition of fair

I actually consider paying for this app, and I rarely do. Great job on making it. 😃 I'd like a few better game review comments though. Some of those I've got have been a bit self-destructive (unless I miss some obvious strategy). Also, I'd like an option to buy the unlockable features for a set period of time. I know it's a good tactic to keep people paying by making a contract, but the subscribe-just-to-unsibscribe-immediately, usually stops me from committing.

I've been enjoying this app for a while now, and it's been good. I just can't with these ads, though. It's one thing when they pop up, you know, once in a while and you're able to X out of them, but now they're forcing me to go to the app store before I can close out of them. It's getting ridiculous. They're slowly getting more and more invasive. This app is getting more and more unusable. Alright guys, I'm ready for the AI-generated response about how ads keep the app running or something.

Chessdotcom has a lot of expensive subscription features that can help improve your game. The free version doesn't share knowledge or information as the internet was originally intended. Some will say "you get what you pay for", but we already pay for it through taxes, utility rate increases, and isp fees. 120 usd is ridiculous for any app subscription. Drop it to $2 and sell 100 million, or keep it up and only sell 100k. It is just a game and you can get the same for free.

Best chess app there is, this app has it all. the subscription for game analysis is fairly priced. not bombarded with ads either. Puzzles, coaching, lessons, you can play versus bots, other players, or friends and set up the game to time specifications. Customize the board/sounds. the runescape sound effects were a pleasant surprise. The skill levels of the computer algorithms are broad. If you not only enjoy chess, but want to get better at it, this is the app for you.

Not sure exactly what happened here from a few years ago, its now very arcadey in the UI and such. plus, the AI will trade every piece seemingly regardless of strategic effect. making it difficult to deploy pieces in ways that threaten any opposing piece of the same kind, even when defended and other parts of the board are in contention, and the trade being an actual strategic loss for the AI. Needs some work on that front.

If you are into chess, even a little, you should try this. I never got into chess much, but I was recently invited by a friend, and things just clicked. Great training aids, videos, professional help, and chess puzzles. You can play people, or Bots, and almost everything can be customized to your style. Don't like the vacation settings at all. I have played several people who abuse the feature to avoid losing by timeout. Vacations are fine but should be scheduled, not used to avoid the rules.

Addition of video ads went too far. I've been playing mostly the bots and challenges, but today was the first time I've had a video ad pop up when I started a game. It's just a few seconds to play, but it's really annoying, and I don't like the app enough to want to deal with the annoyance. Flew too close to the sun for me.

I have been using this app for a long time and have generally had a positive experience. However, when I recently encountered an issue and tried to contact support, I realized there is no way to reach a human representative. The issue I am experiencing is that games are being marked as abandoned before the one‑minute timer expires when I switch to another app. This is causing penalties despite me returning within the allowed time. As a long‑time user, it is frustrating.

it was a good chess game, until recently I have noticed that nearly everything k click on, it gives me a ad. I open a daily game and make a move, it gives me a ad. I solve the daily puzzle, it gives me a ad. I finish a game, it gives me a ad. its still a fine chess game, the ads are annoying me a little. Also the fact you have to get premium to do more than 3 puzzles daily or to reveiw more than one game a day for free. but still is a good chess game even without premium

I've had this app for a few years. It still is the best chess app there is. Over the last year it's gone from absolutely no ads to an ad farm. pay to remove and ads between games etc. super annoyed the game developers went this route. Definitely puts a stain on the quality of the app for me.

Please give a clear notification when you go offline during an online match. I played my move and waited and waited, thinking my opponent was taking time, just to figure out I was disconnected from WiFi and had been auto-resigned. If I had known that earlier, I could have done something.

update: the popus are a annoying! site is laggy, it feels all about the money now. The app is now super annoying with popups after a game is done. I try to access the chat after the game is over and popups get in the way and I click the wrong thing! I don't need to be reminded every damn time I use the app that I can do this or that!!

Ive been using this app for years the only issue I have is there are settings that are added that can't be turned off that are annoying also some of which eat some time when they activate. If there was an option to turn them off 5 stars but until then 4 and maybe 3 if it takes to long to fix.

inconsistent moderation, at best. They also have ads in the app. This normally isn't bothersome, but they recently changed it so that you have to exit the ad twice to remove it. This traps you, because if you accidently click the link it takes you to the app store. Predatory, greedy practices by a company that pretends to care about chess. Company responded, but I couldn't trust a bunch of cowards to fix it right.

The app is really well done and it was a pleasure learning how to play chess with it. I, however, am sick of people quitting the game when they are about to lose. It takes away the enjoyement of the game and it ends up increasing your difficulty level even when the person resigned/abandoned the game really early on. Stop playing chess if you are not ready to learn by losing. Please consider adding a feature to reduxe the amount of times this occurs, it's actually quite bad🥲

I found the opening teaching technique completely inappropriate. A video of about 20-30 minutes and then having to solve a few problems in challenge mode! In such a long video, I keep on mastering the technique on one hand and forgetting it on the other.

Worst way to play Chess, but unfortunately the only online website + app to have lots of players at every level of ELO. Cluttered UI on website, good on app, but both push their overpriced subscription, 'premium' which gives you features you can find better versions of and for free on various websites.

Many players, always someone online with my skill level, smooth playing, no connection issues, I get compensation if someone is using a bot against me. I am paying the annual subscription and it is totally worth it with unlimited lessons, puzzles and game analisis.

one of the worst game i have seen...very poor rating system...after certain rating and sometimes worse matchmaking like you 530 you could get opponent of 580...you cannot make any progress as it give +8 for win and -8 for loss .. so overall no progress if you loose any game. if you try to recover it will draw you in cycle of lose win . and the 3 min blitz game is so annoying and so addictive that i might loose my cool when i ended up by loosing with time. and puzzle after 7 streak get hardest.

After taking a break for about 2 years, all of the features that actually let you train have been locked behind a PayPal. I'd understand if you made new feature and locked those, but no, everything that made this app special is gone. Thanks a lot, now I have no free way to learn chess!😐

Some of the ads have a fake close button. Edit: I understand the need for ads, but using dark patterns is absolutely unacceptable. when I click on the X in the corner, the ad should close; not open a browser to a potentially malicious website.

Doesn't work at all. I've upgraded the app and hopefully that fixes the bugs. It moves my piece for me, somewhere different from where I'm moving it. Or takes a move away. I touch a piece and it counts that as a move. A few fumbles are understandable but this is crazy. If the upgrade doesn't fix this I'm done with this application.

Honestly, lots of good thing things to say. Unfortunately, I'm going to concentrate on the negative. The most recent update brought a lot of the desktop features to the mobile app, which is great, however I have the hardest time in the world starting the very first game of any given session ever since the update. After you cajole the app to start the first game of the session, everything works seamlessly including subsequent games. Fixing this not only earns 5 stars from me, but also a paid membership.

It's so frustrating that even the bot games are limited in game review count unless you pay. As a learning tool - no, as a hub for overall free competitive and ranked gameplay - sure. the design is nice, frequent non-boring events are also a great addition.

square letters are too small. Board in analysis looks too similar to the board in real game - shall have eg. different board colors. I did not manage to generate PGN or FEN from the played game. The same about running played game back in analysis mode with suggestions for better moves

Bad UI update. Was forced to update since my installed old version will be obsolete. The new UI sucks especially at the homescreen, what's this UI? A commerce app? Previously i just need to tap 1 button to instantly enter a 1 minute game with just one hand conveniently. Now i need to tap the Play button (which is at the bottom), then game options menu show up, then tap Start Game (which is at the very top). Very inconvenient for when I'm looking for a quick game.

Everything else is fine. But when I want to screen record despite using many different screen record apps, it still can't fetch the audio of your app sometimes. As if the app turns off/on sound detection for my screen recorder by itself. As a small content creator who plays this game for fun, this is very inconvenient.

game is good. why i am rating 3 star is because when we play match with low internet connection(even moderate) even after we move piece it takes additional time like 20 sec in my pc this leads to easy win for opponent team. thing is you should better stop us to take match other than wasting points for match which we might win. but overall it is good. just that one issue. i am requesting you to fix this then i will rate 5 star.

Bullet chess on mobile is, outside of puzzles, pretty much the only thing I play on mobile, as I rarely have time for longer games that I couldn't spend on my computer instead. Bullet on mobile is horrible. You lose 1-3 seconds at the start of the game due to the banner that appears, showing each player. Moving pieces with the thumbs is already much harder and slower than with a mouse, and often I find pieces dropping one square before where I intended to place them. Altogether frustrating

update: An actual human emailed me and we went back and forth a few times to resolve. Excellent communicarion & service. For this reason I am updating stars. OP: I want to purchase while its on sale. But I cannot get any assistance except AI which is not answering why I can't chat. Opponents send me stuff. I can read it when it flashes on screen but when I go into chat there is nothing and it says disabled. The instructions AI gives me says to resend email activation. That's not even an option.

Feels like Duolingo for Chess, not a fan of the style, but there's some nice puzzles and exercises to get you thinking. I don't like how quickly you hit a pay wall as a new user, 3 small puzzles doesn't exactly give you a proper feel for how it will be with full access.

I love how it helped a total beginner like me to learn about strategies and tactics which are used by high rated players and also those bots are good for training. Online matchups sometimes feel tough like you are facing some elite player who is not your range of rating but it happens in all games. First brilliant move was all it took to develop more interest in game engine. Kudos to the developers

I have been to a lot of improvement in chess please install the app especially when you pay for gold platinum or diamond u are going have puzzles, learn and matches. You can even challenge your friends. This game is really awesome 😎. If u keep playing with others u can make a difference. I really want you to have this app.

My original rating went from a five star to a three star because of ONE feature I find unnecessary and annoying. The undo button on mobile. Playing against bots is probably the cornerstone of this app since its a free way of practicing chess skills, but having that undo button seems such a waste when there are these arrows that goes back and forth moves. At least give the user an "Are you sure...?" in case of an accidental tap on the undo button.

The premium version is reasonably priced and definitely worth it. Unfortunately, after converting the price to my country's currency, it becomes too expensive. Still, this game is amazing,Please do something about it.

charging to see our stats now? Classy move! Anything to make an extra buck huh!? Lets not mention the amount of times you force a draw even when I have plenty of time is wild!! Your updates are fixing the wrong problems... updates since the reply; you justified my complaints but not only that but an emotionless bot responded NOT A HUMAN!!!!! I also noticed moves from players at 1100 elo that are playing way higher than 1100!!! I can't test my real skills if I'm playing a computer?

My account was banned unfairly due to what seems to be a misunderstanding. my younger brother Also plays on the same account, which may have caused unusual rating differences and led to confusion. I never used assistance or cheated. Additionally, I was never given an option or warning to move to a higher skill level before the ban.

Gone down hill. New piece move and capture sound is overbearing, buggy and sounds like it is clipping/distorting plus doesn't work sometimes. New animations are disorientating especially when playing speed chess plus you can't switch them off. Recent starting game animations block starting moves by 1 - 2 seconds stripping time from your clock. Using Samsung S23 Ultra.

That is the best chess game for mobile devices(even the website). It has a variety of unique puzzles, ability to compete with people around the world, have friends and have various achievements. There are many types of chess games such as Rapid(10 minutes, 30 minutes,etc),Bullet(1 minute, 3 minutes, etc) and more. But for the premium version, you need to pay for it. The premium version unlocks more puzzles, and many more.

CHEATERS GALORE!!! way too many try-hards and cheaters playing well above the level displayed. unfortunately there's no way to pick and choose a region to play in. you are thrust into a world of people who have been playing chess since the womb. would be nice to only play in your country. also, too many players who discriminate against you because of the country you live in. as if you were given a choice where you were born. you can report players but i don't believe anyone moderates this game.

by far the best chest app I ever used but I think there should be one more thing that should be added which is casual match so you don't lose or gain ELO (so you don't have to face opponents that is better than you) since on ranked you can get pushed up and down so you'll never learn your mistake if you end up fighting worse opponents

I say the app is good but the game review needs to be a little more free and puzzles and everything to learn is p2w but for free you only get a few per day and many bots are locked I wish there was a way to unlock bots based on your rating like if you are 1900 you get some extra bots if 2000 some more and the starting bots being less is better to make the game more competitive still I will write some other reviews later. and also free trials in my nation are not available so what to do.

very good if you like chess and being humbled by other people online.Although this is still the best game out there for chess for one the reasons I am rating it only four stars and not five is because of the lack of game reviews for free to play!!! As this is a unique and highly helpful feature that I only wish I could use more then once a day!!!However,if you want to use it anymore you need to pay up.If you did not have to do so or if you at least had a few a day then I would do five stars.

this game is probably one of the most addictive games I've ever played, and it's really fun too. but i don't understand the way it adds and removes points, instead of the standard +8 or -8 you get when you win or lose I've been losing 8-10 points per loss and when I win I only get back 6 or 7 which is very very annoying, even draws minus points from me now whether I was in a better position or not and I can't understand why. please do something about it

Slow and slippery interface, not really suitable for bullet games. Also not possible to highlight the piece without showing the legal moves, which is a nuisance. And pre-move feels strange too. The old lichess app works much better.

really the only chess game you can play online.it would be nice if the chess variants could be in the app and not have to go to the website.also a really cool addition is more access to the decoration like even CUSTOM clock themes and etc. but overall the apps cool and helpful with learning the amazing sport chess. Hopefully someone like a moderator or dev.BTW IM AM NOT A BOT

awesome. after playing online games you can review your game to see what better moves you could've done which is great to improve you skills! If you are looking for a chess game this is the best one you'll find :). it's also mostly free. you have to pay I think to do more than 3 puzzles, otherwise it's a great chess app!

The app is great, with easy to learn ui and most features being free. The membership is also fairly priced. The only problem that I faced is that sometimes the bots just freeze on their move, or the app crashes. Another thing is that if you are white and you play your move and then select abort, it counts as resignation and you lose elo. Please fix this.

I think I say chess is a game for not intelligent people it is for learner i like to say may be my english is not correct but this AAP is perfect for Playing chess i like the ui and bots in app also one point is frustration feels when I lose 2 or 3 game in row. my mental health or frustration level go up. but also when I win and increase my rating it's feel very good at time. this game is all about mind training or best for focus. and suggest best app to learn English.

The gameplay is great, matchmaking seems solid. I've been playing for a few years and have the same complaint I've seen from others recently, I get the subscription model but constant ads makes me want to stop using the app. I've been closing out the app and reopening every time an ad comes on. I get it, you gotta make money, but I'll likely be one of the users you lose to do so.

Terrible setup board UI. Loses data 24/7 and completely bugged "Invalid Position" checker ruins any chance for analysis. Not only does it mark nearly every position as "Invalid", why would you even bother checking this in the first place? Who asked for this? Why not allow me to play out """Invalid""" positions if I want? What, are you going to send the chess cops after me? Ridiculous.

It used to be great. Then, they kept developing and developing it until it sucked. Puzzles are a miserable experience now (why I canceled my annual premium membership), game reviews no longer let you just review the game, and the game list visual settings get messed up and you can never fix them again. If they roll back to how it was in 2024, I'll pay $100 a year again.

This is the great so far. but I really hate its puzzles rating system. when I win any puzzle it only increases +2 or +3 points. and on losing +13 and +15 points are decreased. This is so irritating and frustrating.

The reason for the 2 star review, isnt anything wrong with the client. Its the users, foreign or domestic. the amount of people who cheat in a game of chess is pathetic. And there is no real punishment for doing so. All they do is run the game vs a high level computer making the same moves you make in a game. And have near perfect play from starting ELO of 100, all the way up the ladder. Trying to find a casual game, is almost impossible.

The app policy is absolute nonsense. Once you start getting better at the game, insecure players keep getting you banned. Win five games in a row, and your account probably will get deleted permanently. Wouldn't recommend to spend your time and money in this app. Looks like scam, because it's designed to kinda support only beginners, to put it mildly.

would be way higher if last updates werent so mindboglingly ugly and distracting. Why would i want flashy animations , and jumping circles in my main chess app?! i loved silly flashiness of the old games , but in the de-facto the main and only way to play chess online??? why would i? its plainly irratating. i like dilly graphics and animations , sure. but rhis isnt even silly. its just rhere to force you go into setting looking for a way to turn it off

I love this kind of Chess app.—You can play it anywhere and anytime you like, because it can be played both offline and online. Also, I really like those bots. You’re not just learning and shaping your mind at Chess opening, puzzles and suitable strategies; Communication is always there too.
