ilove this app but sometimes if iam wining the time not funtion even the signal is good...It feels like evrything is already controlled by the system even the elo rating,idont know just saying

The best chess app there is, I like it! I also like how you can chat online to your actual friends. But I want a feature in which we can send photos as well. Also please make another feature that includes the variations, such as the crazy house,spell chess, or four player chess. Finally, can you make older bots, like the Duolingo or Mittens back? Like a comeback for the bots, but only for a limited time. Overall:10/10!🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

Chess is a classic game that has been around for many years, and basically, everyone has at least heard of this game. This app pairs you against many different people who are around the same skill level so you can learn and have fun. You can also play against chess engines to give you a harder challenge. The subscription does also unlock many other things you can use to practice. Chess is an insanely popular game with many great players and gives you the opportunity to play with friends!
too many adds, lichess feels like the better app. puzzles being limited to 3 a day seems scummy. analyzing matches being limited to one a day also seems a bit much.

this is amazing app but has a glitches. Today I played 1 minute matches and in two of them I could not move other figures than king. And king was not under attack. Looks like game ignored pawns between enemy queen and my king.

The app language is locked to the system settings. I am not willing to change my entire device's language and region just for one app. This issue has persisted for over a year without being addressed. Please add a manual language selector.
great but have to but pro but it doesn't have ads so it evens everything out

The fact that a player can abandon the game when the position is not favorable to them is frustrating to say the least. Who regulates this? Why allow players to get away with this. I can understand if it's a one off thing, but this happens way too often. Ban them for a month if they are reported for anything that hinders the true game of chess being played.

It's over. I used to play this app every day. Full page ads for their OWN service. You KNOW it's not because of money if they are only advertizing themselves and their premium service. Because it's not sponsored! It's them interrupting you SPECIFICALLY to bother you into paying to remove their interruption. Which is actually disgusting. Then they lie and claim it's to keep it free. Like an abusive partner saying it's you're fault they are hitting you.
great, used to be in chess club and then year's later found this. 10/10. 5 stars. ultimate chess site.

Somehow they started charging ME AGAIN AND I HAVE NOT SIGNED UP. I WILL BE REPORTING THIS APP TO THE PROPER AUTHORITIES. SCAM. Signed up for a free trial very recently. Now I get a bill for $150 ????? Seriously? Cancel and refund ME ASAP. PLEASE.

Can I look back at a past game without a popup window opening every single time pleading me to start a subscription in the form of 'Game Review' ? No, I don't want a membership. You asked. I said no. Leave me alone now please. Once should be enough.

The online chess against other players is very good. No complaints there. My problem is with the tactics & daily puzzles. It's annoying that you only "get it right" if you solve the puzzle exactly the way the app decides it should be solved. That's stupid because there are often multiple ways to get to the same outcome & yet any other way you try is wrong. I literally went & analyzed today's puzzle & tried a different way, & I still solved it, but according to the app my moves were "incorrect"

New version went overboard with ads... So unnecessary and kills the experience. There are better free options now. EDIT: Yes. I'm aware ads are what pay for the development. There were ads before that were only mildly annoying. Now there a full screen ads you can't dismiss, on par with the most annoying pay-to-win mobile games out there. I've paid for premium features in the past, and they were nice, but making the free version annoying is going to backfire.

Excellent for playing online, offering an enjoyable and engaging experience. However, I've encountered a frustrating issue: if my network connection drops momentarily while playing a game, the app fails to reconnect automatically. The reconnection timer runs down and that means "loss by abandonment ". My friends also complained of encountering the same issue. If possible try to look into that issue.

I can't see the move classifications in post-game analysis anymore since it's no longer free (as it had been for years). This helpful tool was obviously put behind a paywall to drive up sales, but it's not worth paying for even at the lowest tier. If Lichess's mobile app was halfway decent, I would have switched long ago. Edit: I don't want full game reviews, especially when they're locked behind a paywall. I just want to see where I made mistakes. Bring back the basic feedback!!

The 5 stars is for the website as a whole rather than the app. The app doesn't have all the features of the website, which can be annoying. You can't access vote chess from the app, for example. However I'm a diamond subscriber and I spend many hours on both the website and the app. I find the diamond subscription excellent value for money. The tactics trainer is extremely useful, as are the videos.

I really like the game and how easy everything is set up. Nevertheless have a lot of time issues, whereby in a 3 minute game I have almost 1 minutes gap between me and the other player. Also sometimes the player has 2 seconds left and I have like 15 and still loose on time..that make it a bit hard to subscribe to the game since I know I cant do anything about it and is just some kind of glince.

The big issue I have is the daily puzzles. they only give you one "correct" move that no experience player would make. if it really is the best move, though all other evidence suggests it's not, then there needs to be an explanation of the long term strategy. for example, today's puzzle 4/23/19 has me giving away my queen for free through a pointless check before taking the opponent's free queen. If this app is being marketed as a learning app, the solutions to the daily puzzles should make sense

I now have to watch an ad before I even queue for a game with the recent update. Sure, it's not an issue if you play longer games (10+ minutes) but I play chess to kill a few minutes here and there in a blitz or bullet game (1-5 minute timers) while I'm waiting in line, on the toilet, etc. This makes the ads a much more significant percentage of my time in the app and isn't worth it any more so I'm uninstalling. The unobtrusive ads were never an issue, it's the ads to join queue that I dislike.

This was the best chess game ever, but I discovered, when I was playing online. I had 4 secs left, and had a checkmate in 2. But for some reason, even after I moved, the timer kept going leading to loose my game. Also, almost every game, I lost time when it wasn't my fault, while my opponent got more time than me, like 10secs more.If it happened once, I would still play, but it kept on going for a lot of games. My internet was also good, so I do not know why this happened. Can you help fix that?

This was a great app to analyze your games through the custom game mode. You could set up the pieces and it could recommed moves, show where you made a mistake or blunder. You could also use the 2500elo bot to show you the best moves; however, they took all this out to promote premium subscription, which is unfortunate. If the analysis mode from premium is the same or better, it is one of the best out there, but I don't play chess seriously enough to pay for the best analysis over a free one.

Been playing a while & it's made me a faster, more confident player. The downside to this is i have to learn to keep focus as other players can be slow, don't know if that's a strategy ? There's always the timer ! The daily puzzles force you to think in terms of sacrifice & strategy. I had always played defensively, but have learned its advantageous to be more aggressive . Has been addictive at times ! I've improved, but consider myself as a mediocre player atm, one has to be more honest !

I've tried a lot of other chess apps, and none of them have as many features than this one. It has puzzles, lessons, games, coaches and more. And the lessons are very thought out and detailed. One of my favorite things are the coaches, where they play against you and guide you through the game. It appears on the website however I can't find the coaches on the app. The puzzles are really good too. There are a lot of modes for puzzles I just wish you could do more then one puzzle a day.

Since becoming a paying customer, my experience with the app has gotten worse. I've gotten more pop-ups recently asking me to spend more money. I can no longer see when I'm making book moves, great moves, or misses on the analysis board, and I can no longer see the swings of the game at a glance as soon as a game ends. And as of recently, I can't even see my puzzle rank while doing puzzles. I can't justify spending money ever again.

The app is simple to use and makes your practice very efficient. Lessons are well-structured and introduce chess concepts slowly but continuously. One lesson per day might not be enough for everyone as per the free version limit, but prices are fairly low, and one might also consider simply purchasing the gold tier to meet a fair amount of tactics, puzzles and lessons per day! Just a quirk: if during a lesson you happen to rotate the screen, the lesson crashes and you need to restart it!

Great app. The low rating is for the bad practice of hiding the cancel subscription button. I could not find the option in the app, only in the browser and only after searching on Google for more than 5 minutes. Edit: Added one star for the reply and support. In the app, in more - > Membership there was no clear way to cancel, I could upgrade or change to other plans but did not have an obvious way to cancel completely.

Only problem is: you have people hacking at chess. There is a 3 minute speed game and when you play against someone, your pieces are moved into place without you doing anything. I played 4 games of it and each time, my pieces were moving on their own and they were moved to be easily taken. It wasn't a connection issue. It wasn't a game issue. I believe you have people who are so bad at chess that they have to cheat just to win a game to up their rating. It doesn't happen on regular 10 min play.

If you are playing this & are up in the match against on of the characters & are poised to win, DON'T save the game. Play until checkmate, because the game seems to be programmed to cheat in that moment. You will find if you go back to the saved game that the engine has moved the pieces back a few moves to an earlier position in the game. So you are no longer in a winning position. Other than this glitch the game is a good challenge for the chess enthusiast.

So far, I have not had the menu say that there was no internet since my review was responded too. Things seem to be going back to normal. I just wish that there wouldn't be an achievement to get the premium membership 💎. I don't like buying in-app purchases, but want to get all achievements in chess - play and learn. ♟️ Please and thank you. Good day. 📅 Like the puzzles.

Santiago (850) is destroying me. I feel like he makes zero mistakes, nothing to work with. It's clear he is not playing as intended after I played the same bot on PC and it was a cakewalk. Is there any way to know what rating the computer was actually playing at? Otherwise a fine app. Some of the puzzles are a little sus, I've seen a few that depend on opponent making bad moves.

This is one of the best apps for chess if not the best. It not only lets you analyze your game so you can see what you did wrong but it also shows you what the best moves were and what you did wrong. The one thing I don't like is that theres no button to report a player. Peopel do the "technique" where they have two phones, in one theyre playing online and in the other theyre playing with an BOT and copy every move that it does. They move so quick, in hard situations. So this is the only thing.

Best place to play chess against other people. It's free but has some pay walls e.g puzzles and lessons, but for what it's worth it gives you a couple of free "premium" features a day like the puzzles. The price for the premium features get quite expensive but there are options for somewhat restricted premium features if you'd like to improve maybe consider buying the premium features(monthly/yearly renewals).

The app is overall good but is severely lacking in it's capabilities to play with known friends. When you generate a challenge link, it redirects for the website version of the platform instead of the app. The challenge link when open from a mobile device should open in the app. There should be something like a waiting room for the game requests that have been sent to you, so you can find them easily and accept or reject them. Right now, if you miss the notification there is nothing you can do.

If you intend to grow a career in Chess with ratings and titles, this is the place to be with all basics and lessons, openings, game analysis, online opponents (including the real life Grandmasters), tournaments, and daily puzzles. You still can work it out, even if you dont want to invest dime in the app. I recommend it for kids as well.

Good enough, but it lacks two very important features that are in the desktop version, premoving more than ove move, and drawing arrows, like I don't get why not just add them, not to mention the variants that are only on desktop version, but I don't really play those, this app will get a generous two stars for now. Ps. Please focus more on adding arrows because it is CRUCIAL to my calculation.

I like playing and the free daily puzzles, but I would like for the lessons, openings and other things to be free also! I understand that we have a limited amount without the plans, but give all chess lovers ways to improve our games even if we have a limited income! I want to better my openings, defenses and learn great details about games to get better because I haven't been playing in a while and want to get good enough to get into competition!

I used to love this chess site. Until Lessons only became one a day and having a certain amount of puzzles. I do not think paying 29.99 for just more puzzles would not make any difference than Lichess having unlimited amount of puzzles and other Traps and opening you can study that was made from other people to teach you. I love the Graphics of the pieces, Different customizations of boards, and having your own photo for your background. Other than that, it is nice.

Loved the app HOWEVER..a NEW update came in and it suggested I either agree to the new terms or feel free to delete my account. I already hate sharing my location, personal, contacts and other private identifying information but you want more from me or else..GTFO of my phone. This app has completely sold out casual chess players to data aggregators.

Good game for playing (and learning, if you pay). Big drawback is that you only get very few puzzles/lessons to do for free until you reach a "weekly limit"?! Could've at least be a 1-lesson-daily-limit, to actually encourage people to learn and enjoy the game more. Instead there is a 1 lessons (of 7 minutes) per WEEK limit, and 2 game reviews per DAY limit, then it starts asking you for premium, and it's not even that cheap..

It's a 5 star rated game but I rated 4 bcoz one thing I dnt like about is when u play online,we dnt know even the player is left or not have to wait for all 10 minutes to declared win.I wish if there was time like 1 min to move a pawn or else will declared winner like other chess do...if not it's very boring...hope we will see this in next update...plz dnt let me uninstall this chess app bcoz of this.

I'm rated around 1200 at the time of writing (Dec 2024) and it is a great app for learning, playing, and understanding chess. You get one free analysis of a game per day. 3 free puzzles not including a daily puzzle. You can play games from 1 min to 2 weeks. I personally think you should get more services for free as not everyone can afford it but other than that its an amazing app and in under a year got me from 100 elo to 1200 elo (with books and videos aswell)
This is the best app to play chess At the begnning I don't know how to play but now I continously winning 🔥

Great game! The user is able to play online, solve puzzles, learn chess, and play against an AI coach. There are ads, but they're not disruptive and can be skipped (shown usually at the end of a match but are small and able to skip quickly). The user can pay to unlock unlimited puzzles but is not needed to play. You receive a score, ect, and create custom matches against an AI bot. Overall, it's a great game and lots of fun. I definitely recommend this app.

Great game, easy to learn, and in generally just a nice way to pass the time, though the a issue I have about this game is the elo, I'm a pretty low ranking (probably like 400 elo) and o do yes, get matched up with people of the same eli, but the problem is is that most of the people I play against probably have also ranging from 600-700, so most of the time I'm losing. Thinks it's kind of a skill issue, but still it can be annoying. Edit: I'm pretty sure I just suck at chess.

Good app to play and learn chess. Free versions gives you a few puzzles a day, lesson a week and some other stuff, but as far as I can tell you can play as much or as little as you want. Lessons are really good, I do wish I could revisit older ones without triggering the 1 lesson a week free limit Opportunity to join leagues and tournaments if you're into that. One flaw is challenging friends, your rating can become inflated, so when you play someone random you get matched to someone way better

NOT worth $10 a month. If you're just brushing up or want a little training, this is WAY overpriced. App is pointless unless you pay. You get very short lessons, and only one a week, unless you pay. No way to review what the lesson is, unless you open it and waste your one for the week. Obviously this is just another cash grab by developers hoping you'll take the "free" 7 day trial and forget to cancel.

Gui is fine. Computer opponent's are fine. Matchmaking is perhaps the best thing here. Only lets you play a couple puzzles per day unless you have a paid membership. The analysis post game is the biggest dissapointment. They will lie to you. I have screenshots that show they say completely different things to each player such as which moves were best, excellent, blunders ect.

Too many "try premium!" traps. Can't do much of anything in this game that you can't in other chess apps without constant premium popups. I'm a casual chess player looking to learn. I'm not paying over $100 a year for the privilege of being able to review moves more than once. Also, the game occasionally blocks perfectly legal moves for absolutely no reason. In my most recent bot game, I was forced to blunder my queen because it refused to let me move her like a rook.

So I see a mod responded to my original comment. Here's the thing, if it's one of your highest priorities then I don't know why you can't figure out what's happening. I literally just explained it. Better than 7 games in a row today it happened. It's utterly impossible for a moderately decent player to advance given the cheating. The games going great. I'm way ahead or positionally superior. A long respite follows then 6 straight moves that crush me. You aren't looking....
This was the best chess app I've ever used. And then they ruined it with ads. I'd even be fine if there was a one time purchase for removing ads. I'd gladly pay $60 one time to remove ads

Lichess is better and free. Since there are alternatives, I will simply take the time to desribe the most aggravating (and I have tested my theory several times) problem : when I did not pay for a membership, my opponents were equally matched and had good sportsmanship but after buying a membership, there were long waits to finally be matched against a player with ratings that are +/- 200 to 300 different than my own. Players who were unfairly matched would simply stop playing halfway through!

On the whole this app is ok. However, If you buy gold membership you're supposed to be able to play 25 tactics puzzles per day, but the counter routinely fails to reset until a random time, leaving you locked out of one of the best features. It doesn't seem to reset reliably at midnight and it also doesn't seem to be a 24-hour buffer period (which would be unfair anyway). Pretty awful for a paid service.

Overall pretty good game but the only problem I have is on multiple occasions I've lost a match due to not being able to move pieces properly even though none of the moves would put me in check. I'd select my queen or my rook and instead of the usual plethora of options to move I was only given one dot to move to even though I wasn't in check nor did moving the piece affect that. Unless there's a situation I'm unfamiliar with that does that please fix because it's annoying and shouldn't happen.

A great app - but crickey is it expensive for the lessons. Nearly £100 per year for the full version is a *lot* for an app (and that's the only version worth going for - 5 lessons in a week with 'platinum' is just ~3.5 minutes a day!!). I'd feel far more inclined to watch YouTube tutorials and spend that money on several good books where I know I'll get loads of info and which will retain their value. But that said, I appreciate the work gone into this app. It's just too expensive for me.

I think this app is absolutely brilliant. imo the best perk of this app is that you don’t have to ‘wait’ for a player to start a game. You click the play button and within 2 or 3 seconds a match starts. But something I wish for to be changed is that this many things should not be behind a paywall. You get only one review a day. Very few puzzles. You can’t even use the explorer more than a couple times. I know the devs need money too, but atleast let us get more than a few reviews a day.

it's a chess game. you can play games, so it's doing okay there. but there are other apps that do the same thing. so the diff is in what else they do. it's got puzzles, but just 1/day unless you pay. lessons, strategy, etc, again, unless you pay you get only the weakest one. but... games! rated games! with analysis (uhh, if you pay). and you can't save or download the pgn, or look at old games again, or any of that stuff. It does what it needs to, but only the bare min. I'm going back to LiChess

I've been using this for a long time now. I have 200+ hours played in less than a month. Have a diamond membership which I love. I have learnt a lot from the lessons and I'm building my way up the ranks! The only thing I'd like to see is an explanation of some of the puzzles. Some of them don't make sense to me... For instance, threatening a queen with a rook and the queen taking the rook (without being forced to) and then getting taken herself, when she could have moved away. It confuses me.

The worst business model ever. Go to hell with such a bad monetization. I liked puzzles and lessons. But 5$/month for a 25 puzzles per day. I will rather buy a couple of books and will pay for the lessons of great masters then buy you weird subscription. God damn, chess engines are cheaper then your subscription models. I can't believe in this hell. You know what. Play market is a garbage for such developers as you. Stay here forever.

it's good to just play. I feel like there should be slightly more features for the free version. I'm a casual player, so when I'm not playing much, extra features in the free would keep me playing. I don't play enough to dish out the premium price. but would probably do a cheaper paid version. Or even 1 time paid unlocks of features. 5 dollars to unlock unlimited puzzles, etc.

Excellent app for the most part. Playing on a basic (free) membership gives more than enough to make it enjoyable. The only downside is that the mods/staff don't listen to complaints unless you have a fully paid subscription. I have reported other users for abuse, cheating, even death threats, yet when I search their account three months later they are still active. I understand prioritising paying members but not to the extent that they can tell other users to kill themselves and go unpunished

If you would like to experience cheating at its best, get this app. I feel like they are doing nothing about the cheating here, LiChess has better compliance. Playing against a cheater kills momentum and confidence. I literally lost against a 900 rated player, twice, we played the other game in January. Trust me, Magnus has nothing on him.

Price point far too high, discouraging new players who would like to learn from playing at all. Update: After literally dozens of *documented* losses due to running out of time while still having time on the clock, I have attempted to get support for the issue. After literally 15 minutes of fighting with a bot, I was able to get a prompt for a human to assist. IN 3 DAYS. An app with no support, a flawed clock, and a pricepoint so high absolutely should not be allowed on any app store.

great platform for playing chess online. never a problem with lack of players, and in fact even some server strains recently! the team is seemingly working hard to fix the strains though, and I applaud them for that. Very fun platform, but quite a few features are locked behind a paywall, such as unlimited game reviews (you get 1 a day playing for free). otherwise, great platform!

App used to be great. And I mean it's still good, but lately, they're doing things like hiding your "great" and "brilliant" moves unless you pay. You used to get one analysis a day which is reasonable. You get 3 puzzles a day which is fine... but seriously? Hiding that you did something good unless you pay? I used to get a paid subscription every now and then but it's stuff like that that's just going to leave a bad taste in your customers' mouths and make then not want to use your app. Aand 500

all learning tools, like lessons and puzzles, are very limited unless you spend a pretty large amount per month on their membership. I'm sure they have good reason to be so expensive but it's hard to justify someone trying to learn chess to spend over 15$ a month to access it all. not a fan of that. other than that, the lessons are well structured, the puzzles are nice and the game analysis is a great tool to help learn to be a better player

The algorithms that set up the matches are descriminitive, you always get stuck with the same rating group that have the same old tricks. You can't ever grow past your level because it's small points with each win. I feel playing higher rated players gives opportunity to learn more and grow. It's boring playing the same openings and the same tricks. No one has any real strategy anymore. I guess that's how you get people to pay to be a diamond member. However, I keep the app because I love chess

it's perfect, you get to play chess at your level and actually develop. I don't like how much it auto resigns with a slight mistake with the wifi, I like the puzzles and almost everything in it. The best part is that it has very strong players on board for the competition. what I would like to request is increasing the number of analysis someone can get on free mode, it's not everyone who can manage to pay the money especially in dollars 😔

This app is absolutely great but it has a fatal flaw. I'm not talking bout lag and stuff like that since that, probably only 30% of people who play get that issue. I'm talking about the "pay to win" problem. You play chess and you get to a point where you need puzzles and lessons to get better, so don't remove the memberships, just give us more lessons,analysis...etc. As an example give us 10 puzzles per day or even just 2 lesson per week not 1, even just giving more analysises than 1 per day.

Nothing is perfect, but this is close to it. It's not just another chess app, it's THE chess app. You can learn here as a novice with no experience at all so it's your least favorite game, to beating players across the globe, having fair games, and having fun. I only started getting into chess this year, and I'm no longer the worst player who couldn't name the six pieces. And if you're not into chess, there's other variations to play, and you can do puzzles to help learn.Thatsumsitupcauseimoutof

Only completed one lesson. Then you can't do anymore unless you sign up for free trial. Check reviews for stories about others who signed up for free trial being charged. Nearly £100 per year to unlock everything. They do have more reasonably priced tiers. Although these have too many restrictions. Eg. On the Gold level you are still limited to how many lessons you can do. Not great for me as a beginner. Too expensive for what it is. On a positive, app looks good if you'll pay the high price.

I love chess and I love puzzles. you get what you pay for when you subscribe that's for sure. unlimited puzzles that are of equal strength and quality while also being able to utilize a large database of chess games pro and not. a chess engine that helps you analyze and targets areas of weakness specialized to you. I wish I had the full version rn

I pay a pretty hefty fee for this and yet the app is very buggy. Huge lag times, connection issues, won't load, oftentimes it will not show the previous games moves, exits game after a move even when the setting is the exact opposite (stay on game), repeats the exact same tactics lessons within a mere 4 to 5 puzzles, navigation of lessons is somewhat convoluted, matching is poor, attempting to start a game with friends is often impossible. FIX NETWORK ISSUES.

Been using the app for years, my favorite chess app and works good, am also paying 55 euros per year. I do have some minor annoyances with the Analysis tool, it doesn't always show the best move and sometimes it jumps between blunder and best move; in rare cases it doesn't recognize a really good move, because the analyser is limited to X moves. Also missing various features from the web app. However I love the puzzles, I completed probably like a thousand of them!

I've played a bunch of chess apps, and this is by far the best one out there. Player vs Player: Lots of different game timers available, there seem to be a lot of active players so I never have trouble finding an opponent, whether for a bullet game or a game drawn out over several days. Player vs computer: There are a bunch of different AI players with different play styles, and various degrees of difficulty. In addition to chess matches, there are puzzles, lessons, and game analysis as well. After I play a game, the app will analyze my play, point out my bad moves, and offers a lesson on the moves I should have made instead. The lessons offered can teach you to play from scratch, and improve the skills of more advanced players. I've gotten a lot better at chess since using this app.

Excellent app. Great customization, easy to use and commucate. I have one issue; if playing with a friend mobile device to mobile device and I send an invite, they don't receive it since they are signed in on another device. I doesn't affect the game once we get connected but a little annoying. Not going to knock off a star since it's still great.

This app is one of the best games I play to get better at chess and also to show off to my friends. It has online and offline mode, some puzzles and challenges you can do, and also tutorials you can watch to get better. But it does have a limit to how much puzzles and offline bots you can play against. Other than that, it's a solid learning platform, and a go to app if you're planning on learning and playing chess.

Best chess app out there. I would like a feature to be added, which would allow someone to play against any of the bots under some time limit set by the player. This time limit only applies to the player and not the bot. Saying this because I'd like to improve my thinking speed offline. I lose lot of games because of the time i spend in analyzing even after gaining advantages due to time pressure. Thank you!

My gripe with this app is the greedy way that paid subscriptions are structured. The lessons are actually great; they're informative, fun and I was more than happy to pay for a subscription. I signed up for the $7 a month subscription since that definitely seemed fair, I later realised that this lowest tier subscription and it would only allow 3 lessons a week. 3 lessons works out to be around 10-15 minutes total gameplay, having a paid subscription for such a tiny amout of gameplay sucks

Too bad I cant uplaod a screenshot. Players are free to stall the game whenever they feel sour on its results. Gameplay(ing) for les than 3 minutes while opponent stalls for 9:50 only to move last 10 secs, in hopes you'll give up and leave, is a common experience. A report option is available but it wont reverse the any time wasted. LIMIT TIME DURATION FOR EACH TURN!!!!

HEAVY, SLUGGISH, MANY BUGS The more you improve it the more bugs appear. I actually sent multiple emails to them. One bug was that when you play the computer, it takes en-passant a non-existent pawn. Takes a "pawn" into an empty space in the opening. A few more bugs also reported. Not sure if they were addressed. At the moment, in game analysis, it confuses the order of sides to move. When it is white to move, it suggests moves for the black. And vice versa.

Great application. Only one bad thing is how rating / power of a player is calculated, I've been playing with the same guy for a while, when we win, we increase of average 8-10 points and when we lost, we decrease of 15-20. so our rating keep dropping for both of us even if we got a lot better since we started. But overall, daily puzzles, training, videos and challenges are great and help a lot to improve quickly.

Computer cheated, moved king twice as if to castle but had already moved king in the game and also didnt move the ruck to complete the move. in analysis mode its difficult to go through the suggested gameplay to make a faster checkate or missed mate. and it can be impossible to get out of analysis mode without restarting software. although the rest of the platform is spot on.

Account was deleted when I cancelled my paid membership. I lost all stats and scores since I've had my account since 2017. I paid through the middle of March, now I lost all access to my account. Beware if you decide to try out the paid subscriptions!!!!....good luck getting any help on the issue. They have an AI customer support bot who's been telling me "I'll be hearing from them via email about the issue in 1-3 days....." That was nearly two weeks ago, still not a word

A very good chess game with puzzles, lessons, etc. You can play live games in any format you like (bullet, blitz or rapid). The reason i voted four stars is because in mobile there is a problem where you can choose a wrong piece and drop it to wrong square. Many times I choose to move knight to f3 but pawn goes to f3 for some reason. These wrong piece misclicks cost me the game and is the reason i have lost too much rating by losing and have become underrated facing only noobs 😢. Please fix it.

App crashes more than most high end apps (freezes after game). Also way, way too indirect and difficult to find vacation time (people shouldn't need a PhD, come on now). Help articles not accurate on it. Also, unable to clear friend requests on this app. Also I'm not told how much vacation time I have so I have to wait until the last hour and do it manually. Could be more clear to users what to expect, not leave them wondering- people put a lot of time in and don't want it wasted.

This game is good. I got rid of my old chess skills and got better skill, so basically, the main thing I'm talking about is that the game is getting pay to learn. Why? because reviewing the game gives us 1 game per day, which is sucks that we can't learn our mistakes if the game is not paid to learn. The app will be perfect. The rest are good. We can't even play bots as well. Playing the limited given bots will show the same skills. So I would tell that please, don't make this to pay to learn.

It needs a lot of improvement. First of all, the lag. It has a lot of lag issues where you already lose time during your move. Second, the rematch. When you click rematch it takes you out of the game and you just don't know if you really sent a rematch or not. Third, I use Huawei P20 and it has a good processor and all and I don't expect the game to be this slow compared to IOS where you might have the best ever chess app created. Finally, we need an update over this version pleaaaase <3

Changing my review, but there are still some problems with this app. Many people sometimes stall games on purpose or on accident. For example, if you disconnect from a game it usually kicks me out in 15 seconds, but for when others disconnect it takes a long time to have them resign. Like its not their fault and they shouldn't be really penalized for it, sure they should lose elo but shouldn't be reported. Also just revamping the whole thing altogether would be a good 👍.

I was playing a practice round with my brother. I could've sworn I unticked the rated box but apparently I didn't or there was a bug. Of course, since I resigned very early, I got banned. The problem, this app did not notify me of my ban, nor does email. I only know about the ban after an error saying I am when I tried to login in the browser version. I can even play with someone, although very buggy. Now, you can either notify us or make it so it is a bit harder to get banned works for me.

I have been using the app for six months and I was very happy with it. The new version is fine, but I miss at least four features from the former version: 1) it looks too cluttered now (I preferred the previous, more minimalistic look, as I always could go to the website when I wanted a deeper analysis; I know this is a personal opinion), 2) now I don't know what my rating means, the real information was in knowing my percentile (if I was better than 90% or just better than 75%), but now I just get my global ranking, which says nothing because I don't have the total number to which it is compared (and even if I had it, it would be cumbersome to divide my current position by the total every time); 3) the analysis gets stuck quite often, seems slower, and in few cases the whole app crashed, the former was more robust (in fact, there is one game where the progress bar never exceeds 78%, so I get no analysis at all for that one); 4) the former analysis showing in real-time the movements, analysis and rating was a much more interesting to look at than the current boring progress bar (and also saved more time, since sometimes I could just move on once I saw the main mistake). Hope this helps improve this very good app. Five stars if at least the issues 2, 3 and 4 are fixed.

This is by far the best app for chess that I have ever used. It has great lessons. It has online multi-player options. It ranks your skill. It analyzes your games and allows you to improve on mistakes. You can play against computer players of varying difficulty. My only problem with it is that it does still have the occasional bug where it might not send a move right away, or might say it sent it but it did not, or fail to send the notification of a players move. However, this is not common.

I've been using the app a while, and it's good. Does what it says. You can learn to play chess, play against bots and other people to improve your skills, puzzles, all that jazz. My one real gripe is how they changed the game review screen. I don't know if it's still there and I just can't find it, but I liked being able to go through move by move the way it was before the update. Now when you do it it just rushes through and only shows you like 3 moves at most with a random coach head up top.

Having bad Wi-Fi makes me lose rating because abandonment is same thing as resignation now - so rating is falling exactly for nothing, zero moves. Analysis sometimes works strangely, marking an empty square as a threat like it's a mate or there are hanging piece, plus notifications and subscription.. Nah, thanks, at least not now. Two stars, because app is really good by itself, but for me it's simply impossible to play normally.

The best chess app so far, in my opinion, tho as a beginner I would love to have more free lessons per week. I understand that the devs got to eat, but another lessons per week would allow me, and I believe a lot of other people, to drastically improve at chess. Or maybe just an exercise/challenge slot, other than the puzzles (that are great btw), to practice what had been seen in the lesson. We could imagine for example a bot that you must beat with the new opening you just saw. Good game tho.

The original version was amazing. You could view your game history and go through any game, move by move. Every online game came with an analysis at the end that was far more in depth than this version; again, move by move suggestions on how to fix mistakes and inaccuracies. about 3 years ago, I thought to myself, "there's no way a free chess app can be this well engineered towards shaping online players into tournament thinking contestants. I get why they charge for it now, I'm just bummed.

This is a very fun game and a well made app. The only disappointing thing from my perspective is that I haven't won a game yet, as other players forfeit when I have them boxed in. I've lost the majority of games that I've played, and I genuinely don't mind (im still learning to play). But I wish there was a way for either AI or myself to take over the opposition's turns if they forfeit early. Brilliant app though! Well done to the developers.

Loved the experience until recently when the "invalid login token supplied" message popped up and wont go away. Now I cant review games anymore. I've tried logging out and back in, uninstalling and reinstalling, the website, reviewing my account, everything. I just cant use the app anymore. Been using it for over 4 years, and now I can't. I forgot to mention that I have a paid subscription, so I will definitely be canceling it. This was a great app until the new update ruined it.

It's a good app, I like it! It's Just that it's doesn't have as much features as the browser site does. And it's very limited. The Forums, I'm not even sure if you can post in them. The messages, It doesn't even tell you when you get messages. When you're playing a game you have more of a chance of blundering due to a Misclick (for the people who drag there pieces instead of clicking).

Upon finishing the allotted tactics for the day, it shows the diamond in the corner to sell me a sub, but will still let's me play the next tactic(a bug, only happens sometimes). However, it only takes points if I get it wrong and doesnt award points if I get it right. If I'm out of attempts for tactics, either dont let me play another or let me get points for the extra exercise you throw my way. Really just seems to be a programming issue.

Can't imagine it being much better other than if they made everything free. LOL Actually, I'm really perfectly happy with the free version, but I do wish they would allow one or two extra analyses per day. I wonder if they'd be willing to create an even cheaper premium version than currently available that just offers 3-4 analyses per day and maybe a stronger engine to boot. I think I would pay for that.

Lag lag lag lag all day, every game. I got full wifi internet, the came says I'm fully connected, but still every game lags. I only play 1 minute games, so the lag ruins it. It's not fun. Update your servers or something. I feel like I'm playing on a 56k internet connection. Deleted and reinstalled it multiple times, does nothing. Full internet connection. It will work fine for a couple games and then lags for the next 20+ games. No matter how many times I restart. Can't play 1/0 games.

I like the app and I would rate it 5 stars if it wasn't for the lack of notifications options. I literally get an email every time it's my turn in a game. Don't get me wrong I like the notification on the phone, reminding me that's its my move now, but I absolutely hate to log into my email account to find 600 email from this app. There's gotta be a way to remove this.

Hey guys, you must have hired new product team about a year or two ago. Let me tell you - I'm really frustrated by your attempts to increase engagement - ads, emails, app and in-app notifications ("do you want to solve a puzzle" - blocking MY experience). I just want to play a game or two. I ALREADY PAY YOU YEARLY SUBSCRIPTION - and started doing so because I was really empathetic to the cause and your app. But recently I'm really considering to cancel my subscription. Think about it.

This app has helped me Seriously elevate my chess game. It's changed how I see the game by so much. Small critique, though: The puzzle points system, I don't feel it's entirely accurate. A lot puzzles I get wrong, I end up getting right after the 2nd, 3rd, 4th or even 5th try. That has to count for something, right? There should be some way of being able to earn at least just a few points if a person manages to solve a puzzle after multiple tries(without any help, of course).

Great game. Annoying how is always begs you to pay for a premium subscription. Also, please move the "share" button after a match is over; I go to press the "back" button to go back to a main menu right after the match ends, but every single time, the "share" popup takes its place just as I go to click it

I think this app is awesome for playing chess, at all level, I am a level 150, so very low, I would like to learn more, now the only reason I rate it 4 is cause i really want to be able to do more then so many lessons a week, for free, everything else can stay in subscriptions but for people wanting to use ur app for learning, most people don't want to pay for that and just will stop using the app

Some deficiencies with regards to tracking and displaying your statistics. For example, when I look at the graph of my last 30 or 60 days in Daily, it starts at 0 and jumps straight up to my current rating. Also, when you attempt to access a list of the games that contribute to your stats in a particular type (i.e., Daily) it takes you to the main game archive with all types of games shown. That said, this is overall a great way to play chess!

I have been playing this game for a few weeks now and its been quite good. But after recent update the analysis after match got completly messed up, now during analysis the moves do not match what is shown on the screen and some pieces missing from the board. So basically analysis is useless. Also sometimes it stops suggesting moves. I do not want to put less than 3 stars as it is a free to play game, but this got to be fixed

This is probably the best chess app you can get, however it is very predatory in its features, and to be honest, some features don't deserve to be locked behind a subscription. For example, the puzzles. I understand things like analyzing games, or chess lessons, but puzzles don't really make sense being a premium service. It's just another game mode.

It unfortunately has its fair share of bugs but, putting that aside, it's a great app with almost everything a player could hope for built in. Speaking as a person who played for fun as a kid and hadn't played since, the app has lessons to teach you things you may not have learned in casual play (eg, en passant, good ways to help a pawn make it across the board in an end game, etc). There re many players at every duration and skill level as well as daily puzzles to keep you thinking.

It was all rosy before the very last update. After playing a 1min game which I usually play, when I click "New 1 Min" to play a new game, it doesn't work. The search for a new opponent doesn't start like it used to do. Please look into that. It could be a bug that makes the feature not compliant with all devices/OS. Also, this new update doesn't manage speed and Internet connection very well. After the update, my moves became slower than usual, and I unusually lose games on time.

It cheats to make you believe you're a bad player. So that you buy the subscription. Pieces disappear from the board when you're beating the computer. I'm giving it 2 stars because it's a fun app to pass the time and sharpen your skills with. Update*** I'm changing this to a five-star rating because I was wrong. I was schooled by some chess players that the move "en passant" was legal. It was my first time seeing that move. I am truly sorry for my mistake.

I like chess casually. I've played irl with people, and it's nice. But this is BEYOND next level. The rate at which games can be played is incredible. Not only that, but the SHEER QUALITY of every interface is amazing. Not to mention the puzzles and the lessons and the coaches and the amount of options. This is THE app to use for playing chess, on the go or sporadically, against your friends or hardcore. 5/5!

I had multiple issues with this app. 1. 5 min games - my moves would not show or sometimes move to the wrong place. 2. Puzzles - Good but it would help to know initially what the objective is. 3. Custom games - When I select an open challenge, it says Accepted but does not always show on list. 4. System - Just because I win a few games in a row does not mean I am cheating. They deleted my account with no warning after I take a premium membership. Going down to 1 star if I do not get a refund.

Very strange, seems like I'm playing bots on the ladder playing the exact moves and odd lines 5-6 games in a row. Also, when I click play again, I get matched with a player 900 rating when I'm 1200 rating even though it was set to -25 to +50 I'm the previous game. Would be nice to have more content/puzzles for f2p players. Lichess has unlimited free puzzles. Edit: I do set up a custom game which rating works but when I click play again, I get matched with someone 300 points under me.

Best chess game. I love the puzzles and playing against the bots. I like that the bots have various playing style as it makes me explore different aspects of the game. I wish that the developers bring back the two arrows that let you rewind and replay your moves. Sometimes I realize mid game the impact of a previous move and I don't want to wait until the end to analyse. I like to analyse in game and sometimes I just explore from any past move. I think the undo is far less convenient than arrows

I have been using this app for years. Amazing for what it does. I hope the app developers see this. I want to have more notification settings. I lose 100% of the games I play with friends because I don't make a move in time. I usually play the 7 days to make a move option. Although it notifies me, sometimes i ignore the notification when I am out or at work. The next notification I get is the one telling me I lost the game. I wish I could have a reminder every day or before the game ends or the ability to restart the game if the other party agrees. For live chess, it's great because the whole game takes place in one sitting.

Great app, great overall experience. Have a platinum membership and must say 10/10 if you're willing to pay the money. Had it for a year before I got the membership and I think the free version is still an 8/10. Two minor complaints 1. Is on PC I can very clearly see how many lessons I have left for the week yet on mobile i'm missing it ..2 I would like to look at past master games (other than the practice section) like you can on pc (Edit) you can see both on the website but the mobile app

It's good. Simple and easy to use. Also gives puzzles and lessons (just like the website) however limited unless premium is purchased. There are some bugs. I've had a glitch where, when you click play, it doesnt actually put you in a match but then tries to put you in 2 after. However this is an update. Servers need a bit more fixing as lag issues and delay can be seen; especially in bullet chess, I've had a few occasions when my opponent won from timeout despite them being on 0 seconds.

Great server, userbase and engine analysis. The club and team interface I found quite lacking. They need to streamline team matches, add a hub of some sort. Right now it's tough to find good tournaments, clubs, or make quality friends through the app because of this one simple drawback. To be more specific, I'm in 6 clubs right now in order to find good matches. Additonally I have to check them each individually for upcoming events. It's easy to miss, there's no notifications or alerts. 8/10

I love playing, but lots of bugs: 1) when "rematch" is selected, it just freezes on load screen... no way to tell if game has actually started or not (if you press x it either aborts the game, or takes you into game which apparently already started and clock is ticking, giving you time disadvantage); 2) when I am midgame and turn phone sideways (usually accidental), it auto-rotates -- and switches to completely different game I have going! (if I am in blitz game, it switches to my other daily game)

This Chess app is really helpful! I'm about to compete in a chess competition between mine and other schools. This app is quite helpful in my preparations, not only does it let me play with other people worldwide, but it also reviews the matches so that I could gain some useful insights that I could use on my upcoming matches. It also has different modes of playing (such as going against a bot, solving puzzles, bullet mode, etc.) so it never gets boring.

It's literally amazing. if you care at all about chess and want to get better, this is the app to do it. the lessons and puzzles will make you think outside the box and improve your game easy. premium is worth it, but I got mid-tear premium and it's still better than anything else. lots of customization for the chess board and your profile picture is uploadable, you don't have to choose from their library or anything like that, just don't use nudity 😭 5 stars!!

This game is amazing and the bullet will leave you playing it for hours at a time. The only problem I have is that people normally leave when you kill their queen and it's very annoying because the point system isn't that different when you win a game. It's very common and I feel that people should lose more points if the resign. Also the en-passont move with the pawns seem to work for my opponents in foreign countries but not america. I'd like that removed if possible.

It's a pretty decent chess app overall, but would you PLEASE add the option to undo when playing against a computer? I'm relearning how to play and I keep making stupid mistakes. If I could undo the mistakes and try again immediately it would be much easier to learn and remember in the future than to replay a game and hope that when the issue comes again, I remember not to be dumb.

Grate game I just think the mach making is bit wird but other then than that this game is amazing. Edited so the premium payment is bad. The monthly payments for the premium is to much for the average kid to get there hands on so like me I can do unlimited puzzles,no game review,no lessons,and no bots you see where I'm going with this?this limits off at least 50 percent of the game off just that's ridiculous to me.

Free version is very good and if you think you can't see the opponents last winning move against you, which is essential for a beginner, to see how they sneakily won :D the winning screen covers the last move so you close it to see what it was. The daily challenges are great! And the customer support is too :) I like how you can block an opponent's account. I like to play to the end, and prefer opponents that do the same :)

Expensive! UPDATE: the hardest thing to do is UNSUBSCRIBE. To be more specific: prices change inexplicably, even for paying members. I paid an annual subscription, and out of nowhere, I am restricted to only 1 game review per day. This was not the case when I purchased the subscription, and I was NOT notified of the change at all. Making standard chess engines with modest depths available to everyone is ONLY FAIR, but it's UP TO YOU... while cutting them for paying members is a NEW LOW :)

You can't turn the (loud) sounds off, you can't automatically be connected to a partner/new friend based on skill or anything like on other chess games, even though it has themes doesn't have a true dark mode, you can only do one lesson a day unless you pay a ton, and past like, level 8 I'm pretty sure the computer is impossible to beat, even using all the computer's hints, which doesn't make any sense, I like that there are hints, but it seems they only take 2 moves in the future into account.

I've been using the app for years and it's awesome! The analysis tool for each game is pretty cool too, as it identifies your mistakes and blunders then tells you what the best move would've been (I don't always agree but it's spot on most if the time). Just wish more people played 15 minute timed games, but I can always find people for a 10!

Okay so, this app is absolutely great! You can play chess with other people around the globe and you can also play chess with your friends. There is also a chatting system where you can use as a chatbox to communicate with the other person. Though, there is a bug with the chatbox, sometimes the messages don't pass through and it gets really annoying. Overall, this is a great app!

If you enjoy playing chess, whether you're a beginner or advanced, this app is the best. I enjoy getting coached, and playing with people from all over the world. In addition, when I want to challenge the computer, there are countless personalities and levels I can play against, which offer boundless opportunities for improvement. There are puzzles, lessons, videos, reviews and analysis of games, and so much more. And I only use 2% of this app's capabilities. I still have so much to explore.

Its great! The only thing I'd say could be improved is the reliability of the analysis tool, because sometimes it just refuses to work and it's really annoying, because you know I'm paying 50$ for this so I expect it to work most of the time, and also the pricing is really weird because the diamond subscription on mobile is just 50$, but on computer its woah 100$??

Platinum member here. Good app on the whole, but if im paying £45 yearly I would expect to get some opening training out of it. Also the skip lesson button never works, so i have to work through the basics AGAIN. Lots of the time people abandon games when they are not white for absolutely no consequence, which is very annoying. Edit: the video lessons do show opening discussion, nevermind. I still cant skip lessons.

Far more usable than the web version. Erasing the free review, which is already minimal (only overall graphics and moves performance counter) in the web version is really a dicc...ss..appointing move. I hope in the future this mobile version doesn’t slowly descend into the abyss like the web one. (It’s a good thing you can just quickly import the game to lichess. Email me if you guys want to know how. )

Chess with my friends is grand, but 99% of the rest of the app is behind an insanely expensive subscription, especially when all the training and info it offers is also available from many other sources (many of them free). if I could buy this app for £5 I would and I would recommend it to everyone, but with the crazy live-service subscription it loses a star.

A really well made app, and so far, for the few weeks I've been using it, there hasn't been any issues. The reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because I think there should be some sort of penalty for leaving a game. Maybe you can't play for an hour if you leave twice in a row. Because every game that I have played, and gotten close to winning, they will consistently leave. It's very frustrating. This app would be well worth 5 stars if they came up with a solution to people leaving games

Bate and switch. I It's either pay to play or get stuck with pushy "buy buy buy". I understand that it doesn't have to be totally free, but take it easy on all those locked levels. Maybe if they allow people to try more features before forcing them into the so-called "free trial", one might decide to stick around, but the promotion and pushing for "free trial" is too aggressive and a turn off. I uninstalled/it as quick as I installed it.

Used this app as a platinum subscriber for 2-3 years. In that time, the price has more than doubled, and now there's an even higher subscription tier necessary to be able to review games the way I could before this update. I like chess, and this has been a great app for it, but it's gotten too greedy for casuals. Either stay free and accept limited puzzles and manual reviews, or expect to be fleeced.

Like its sister website, this app is extremely slick. Play games online or against AI, analyse them afterwards or during (against AI), follow interactive lessons, learn openings by stepping through lines displayed alongside popularity, solve puzzles, choose a nice theme. The list is endless. You have to pay, but if you know you like chess and want to play/learn without sitting at a computer then this is the one app you need.

Great chess app overall, possibly the best one out there! I do have some complaints though: where can I turn on animations? The pieces now move instantly which is quite frustrating. Also, the captured pieces look very weird under the player's names. They seem too small and just very far apart in contrast to the iPhone version. The iPhone app seemed more sleek.

I play everyday, there are some updates I'm not too happy about. The fact that puzzles and lessons are limited is a bit saddening. I want to get pretty good but I can't always do that if I get only a few lessons a week. but hey people need money. I don't understand why you would need to put this in analysis. a person could record any match irl by writing down the moves free of charge. but we need to pay or this? im guessing it's for the bot or whatever. but that's all i have to say. I like it.

Regarding daily puzzles, it is so time-consuming to go back 1 month to do the undone puzzle. I had a burnout for 3 to 4 months and didn't play in that period. There is no way I can find the undone puzzles and do them. If only there was a daily puzzles calender featuring done and undone puzzles! It would be amazing.

It's fun. My passion for playing Chess is coming back again thanks to the puzzles provided by this app and I enjoyed playing with so many players that are on my level. But there are times that when an opponent is losing, instead of making a move, they'll be idle and not play a move nor resign. It takes a lot of my time, especially if they'd blunder early in the game. I hope there could be a way that players like that won't abuse the system and made them auto resign instead of being negative.

Buggy, upgrade does not work, you pay without getting the upgrade. Customer support is unhelpful and responds always with fake PC sentences and limited to one reply. For instance, they have not contacted me as the developers' reply below suggests. User interface is terrible, for example why one cannot see more info of players when accepting a challenge? Simple things missing. If opponent let the game expires, she gets victory points anyway. Some games freeze when is your turn. No customization option on game list, info on display, nothing! Tournament section is just a piece of the website but does not allow the use of the back button on Android devices, so you have to navigate from the beginning each time. Games that are part of a tournament cannot be grouped or easily accessed. Computer analysis of games often gets stuck after analyzing a few moves.

This app doesn't have the option to deselct a piece once it has been selected before play. It leads to too many errors in the gameplay. Tapping outside the chessboard doesn't do anything. Any tapping on any other piece simply selects the new piece again without the deselect option. Tapping on any empty square works, but if it's a square that's available for the piece to go to, then it would lead to errors. "Move Confirmation" is not really ideal especially in Blitz game modes.

I've been happy with the app mostly, but not the customer service. I cannot get premium membership access. I pay for it via google and my app still doesn't register that I have diamond membership. I paid 20 bucks for nothing! It's been 10 days since I suscribed.. I've sent two tickets with one single reply, and after I complied with the pre-canned requests that support sent me, i was left with no recourse and still out 20 bucks. If this app gives you trouble, don't expect solutions. 1 star.

Updated 02/01/2016. Best chess app for me because of old-style "correspondance" mode, where you have day(s) for each move. If you love chess but don't want to be bothered to move every 20 minutes, this is for you. I still don't understand why it takes so long to refresh the board or send/receive a move, even on wifi... It's a chess game, for God's sake, data transfer should be very fast even if you're sending the whole game back and forth.

Great app to learn Chess and I really like that I can see how I did and where I went wrong after each game (Game Report). Also, the lessons, drills, and puzzles are nice too. In my opinion, the only thing that could be improved is when you're in a puzzle and you make the wrong move that instead of immediately going to the next puzzle, the app tells you why your move was bad.

Their staff are very respectful. I really appreciate how they reply to my questions quickly and helpfully. Some things that the update changed that I don't like is that for some reason, the in game chat, even with friends, is disabled. Also, starting a game seems awkward and a little over complicated, or at least on mobile. Everything else is great though. It exceeds by far any other online board I have ever seen.

Late last year, I paid 29 dollars for a gold subscription. I did so because it was worth the money to have access to all non video lessons, even if I was limited to only so many a day. The fact that this new update makes the vast majority of lessons completely locked for everyone except diamond level subscribers is not only unreasonable, but unethical, considering I am now getting less for my already spent money than what was agreed upon at the time I paid. That's basically theft. Fix it.

Chess works as intended, easy to find a match. However, I've got many gripes with the social side, such as clubs, profiles, etc. The inability to write in another members notes (which was in fact a feature not too long ago) is fairly inconvenient. Adding social features and promptly removing them is very inconvenient and annoying.

Update: after the update, this issue sends to be fixed. Great support and efficiency from the devs. The app is great, but I'm having an issue with it remembering where I've left the lessons off. This is an awesome chess app, my favorite one. I love that there is so many features, so I updated to Premium. I would give 5 stars if it wasnt for the fact that you cant do much without a subscription. Dramatically helped improve my chess game. Playing with friends is easy and fun. Worth the subscription price to see an in depth analysis of every game. The app is really clean, and I recommend getting the $3 subscription to practice on puzzles. Best hobby I've gotten into in a long time!
